code: (async()=>{const E=window.__echoes;const evs=[];E.on('*',e=>{if(['skill_cast'].includes(e.type))evs.push(e)});const tk=n=>new Promise(res=>{const t0=E.tick;const iv=setInterval(()=>{if(E.tick>=t0+n){clearInterval(iv);res()}},4)});const st=()=>E.state();const log={};log.ver=E.version;log.g1=E.cmd('giveSkill','nova_bloom');log.g2=E.cmd('giveSkill','sanctuary');const P=st().party;const ids={0:P[0].id};for(const p of P.slice(1))ids[p.partyIndex]=p.id;E.cmd('teleport',-1.0,-1.5);window.__spam=setInterval(()=>{for(const c of['Digit1','Digit2','Digit3','Digit4']){window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{code:c}));window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup',{code:c}))}E.cmd('setHp',ids[1],0.5);E.cmd('setHp',ids[2],0.5);E.cmd('setHp',ids[3],0.5)},120);const fpsS=[];for(let i=0;i<12;i++){await tk(30);fpsS.push(E.fps)}log.fps=fpsS;log.minFps=Math.min(...fpsS);log.casts=evs.length;log.fx=st().skillfx;return log})()
